claims: The University of Michigan men's basketball team won the 2026 NCAA National Championship.
The University of Michigan men's basketball team defeated UConn 69-63 in the 2026 NCAA National Championship.
The 2026 NCAA National Championship game was on April 6, 2026.
The 2026 NCAA National Championship was the University of Michigan men's basketball team's second-ever title.
The 2026 NCAA National Championship was the University of Michigan men's basketball team's first title since 1989.
Guard Elliot Cadeau scored 19 points for the University of Michigan men's basketball team in the 2026 NCAA National Championship.
The University of Michigan men's basketball team was top-seeded in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
The University of Michigan men's basketball team finished the 2026 season with a 37-3 record.
The 2026 NCAA National Championship was at Lucas Oil Stadium.
The University of Michigan men's basketball team won the 1989 NCAA National Championship by defeating Seton Hall 80-79 in OT.
The University of Michigan men's basketball program has made nine Final Four appearances in 1964, 1965, 1976, 1989, 1992, 1993, 2013, 2018, and 2026.
The University of Michigan men's basketball program's 1992 and 1993 Final Four appearances were later vacated due to NCAA violations.
